pins.pinTitle: Merino wool socks vs cotton: warm feet at camp, even when damp
pins.description: Cotton socks hold sweat and feel cold once you stop moving. Our merino socks (80% merino, cushioned sole, crew height) stay warm even when a little damp. Sold as one pair.
